findings.finding: Publisher confirms twelve cellos only, 1996, 18 minutes, worldwide rental, Bote & Bock, premiere Berlin twelve on 19 February 1997 and recommended Sydney Symphony recording BIS-CD-1696.

BIS official booklet pp.2,6 and27 establishes complete 17:17 released performance by Sydney Symphony cellists conducted by Dean, recorded May2007 and released2008. Describes lone voice against eleven; musical-part independence supported.

grade.basis: BIS booklet describes twelve-way / eleven-against-one musical dialogue and dramatic antagonism; no cello register, bowing or rhythmic technical details. Its virtuosity descriptions concern the viola works, not Twelve Angry Men. Numeric grade withheld.
